summary: A triangular sprite moves through the grid consuming scattered marker pixels that match its head orientation, turning only when matching a marker, until all markers are consumed.
src: triangular sprite with distinct head orientation s
dst: scattered single-pixel markers of same color d
match_cond: s.head.direction aligns with ray to d position (d lies along s.head axis)
path: move(s, s.head.direction) until s.head.position == d.position; consume d; may turn 90° if new d aligns with perpendicular axis
trajectory: s moves without trail; d disappears when consumed
grid_shape: input is horizontally concatenated frames separated by divider; output is single frame of same cell dimensions
multi_step: Step 1: identify triangular sprite and all scattered markers in each frame; Step 2: sprite moves toward marker aligned with head direction; Step 3: consume marker and optionally turn 90° toward next aligned marker; Step 4: repeat until all markers consumed; Step 5: output shows sprite at final position with remaining markers removed
